description: What an application rate is per. Each value fixes its denominator.

values.label: per hectare
values.definition: Amount per hectare of area treated.

values.label: per 100 L, dilute
values.definition: Amount per 100 L of spray at the label (dilute) rate. Tank rate = dilute rate x concentration factor.

values.label: per 100 L, tank
values.definition: Amount per 100 L of the mix actually in the tank (already includes any concentration factor).

values.label: per 100 m of row
values.definition: Amount per 100 m of row length.
